# Randevu.vip — AI Appointment & Revenue SaaS Platform (AZ / EN)

> Randevu.vip is an AI-powered omnichannel appointment booking, shift-aware staff scheduling, and revenue management platform built for medical clinics, dental centers, aesthetic & SPA studios, legal & consulting firms, service centers, and multi-branch businesses in Azerbaijan and globally.

## Official Portals
- **Marketing & Plans Portal**: https://randevu.vip (Default language: Azerbaijani `az`, secondary language: English `en`)
- **Business Workspace & Onboarding**: https://app.randevu.vip (`/login`, `/register`, `/settings`, `/calendar`, `/appointments`, `/payments`)

## Omnichannel AI Receptionist Channels
1. **WhatsApp Business (Default Included in All Plans)**:
   - Instant 1-scan QR pairing inside `app.randevu.vip/settings`.
   - Understands both text messages and WhatsApp voice notes in Azerbaijani (`az`), English (`en`), Russian (`ru`), and Turkish (`tr`).
2. **Instagram Direct AI (Configurable per Plan)**:
   - Connects directly in Settings to answer Instagram DMs and book appointments 24/7.
3. **Telegram Bot AI (Configurable per Plan)**:
   - 1-click Telegram Bot token connection in Settings that automatically registers the live booking bot.

## Payments & Deposits (Enabled Across All Plans)
1. **Cash Payments**: Built-in on-site cash and POS transaction ledger.
2. **Online Card & Deposit Payments**: Instant online card checkout and automated no-show deposit collection in AZN enabled across all plans.

## Subscription Tiers & Dynamic Free Trial
- **Starter (29 AZN/month)**: 1 branch, 1 WhatsApp number, 1,000 AI messages/month, Cash & Online Card Payments, Dynamic Free Trial.
- **Pro (79 AZN/month)**: Up to 3 branches, 3 WhatsApp numbers, 5,000 AI messages/month, WhatsApp + Instagram Direct + Telegram Bot, Voice Notes, Cash & Online Card Deposits, Shift & Overtime Scheduling, Predictive Cadence Rebooking, Flash Drops, Gift Vouchers, VIP Loyalty, Dynamic Free Trial.
- **Enterprise (199 AZN/month)**: Up to 20 branches, 20 WhatsApp numbers, 50,000 AI messages/month, White-Label Custom Domain, Emergency Staff Reassignment, Multi-Branch AI Personas, Weekly AI Growth Advisor, Cash & Online Card Payments, Dynamic Free Trial.
